title: Who may turn twin insight into physical action?
description: Select an intervention, authority path, and delivery condition. Authorization, transmission, actuation, and acknowledgement remain separate facts.

intents.label: Optimize temperature setpoint
intents.detail: A reversible efficiency change based on current process state.

intents.label: Reset maintenance interlock
intents.detail: A privileged action after an engineer verifies the physical work area.

intents.label: Emergency stop
intents.detail: A safety action that must remain available locally during isolation.

paths.label: Dashboard writes actuator
paths.detail: The visualization tier sends a value directly to the device.

paths.label: Gated command service
paths.detail: A policy boundary issues scoped, expiring, idempotent commands to a local controller.

paths.label: Independent local safety
paths.detail: The site safety controller owns the emergency function without a cloud dependency.

deliveries.label: Fresh state, confirmed actuation
deliveries.detail: Preconditions are fresh, approval is present, and the actuator acknowledges the command.

deliveries.label: Stale twin state
deliveries.detail: The site is reachable, but the command precondition is older than its contract.

deliveries.label: Timeout after send
deliveries.detail: The command left the service, but no durable actuator acknowledgement returned.

deliveries.label: Site isolated
deliveries.detail: The orchestration link is down; remote state and command delivery are unavailable.

deliveries.label: Approval missing
deliveries.detail: The twin is fresh and reachable, but no authorized engineer approved the reset.
